meta.name: cohort-analysis
meta.description: Perform cohort analysis on user engagement data — retention curves, feature adoption trends, and segment-level insights. Use when analyzing user retention by cohort, studying feature adoption over time, investigating churn patterns, or identifying engagement trends.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析用户留存与功能采用趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要按群组分析用户行为数据。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze user retention and feature adoption trends
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to analyze user behavior data by cohort.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析用户留存和功能采用趋势。它会读取你上传的 CSV、Excel 或 JSON 数据，计算留存率、发现流失模式，并生成热力图等可视化图表。最后还会建议后续研究或实验。
howto.when: 当你上传包含用户群组（如注册月份）和活跃度指标的数据文件，并请求分析留存或功能采用情况时触发。

say.text: 分析这份用户群组留存数据，找出流失模式。
say.note: Claude 会计算留存率并生成热力图。

say.text: 比较不同群组对新功能的采用曲线。
say.note: Claude 会对比各群组的采用率并指出最快群组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze user retention and feature adoption trends. It reads uploaded CSV, Excel, or JSON data, calculates retention rates, identifies churn patterns, and generates visualizations like heatmaps. It also suggests follow-up research or experiments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a data file containing cohort information (e.g., signup month) and engagement metrics, and request retention or adoption analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this cohort retention data and identify churn patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate retention rates and generate a heatmap.

say_en.text: Compare adoption curves for the new feature across cohorts.
say_en.note: Claude will compare adoption rates and highlight the fastest cohort.
